title: Terms of a Rental Agreement
text:
A rental agreement is a legal contract between a landlord and a tenant. It states the monthly rent, the length of the lease, and the date when payment is due. The tenant must also pay a deposit, which the landlord keeps as security against damage. Both parties should read the document carefully before signing it.

If either party wants to end the agreement early, the contract usually requires written notice. Many agreements state that a tenant must give at least thirty days' notice. Failure to follow this clause may result in the loss of part of the deposit. For this reason, lawyers often advise tenants to keep a copy of every signed page.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what does the deposit provide?
options: A discount on the monthly rent

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what does the contract usually require in order to end the agreement early?
options: A signed copy of the lease only
A phone call to the landlord
Payment of a full year's rent

questions.text: Why do lawyers advise tenants to keep a copy of every signed page?
options: Because the landlord will not sign the lease
Because the document may be needed as evidence if a dispute arises
Because the rent changes every month
Because copies are cheaper than originals

questions.text: What can be inferred about a tenant who ignores the notice clause?
options: They will always get their full deposit back
They may lose part of their deposit
They are automatically released from the contract
The landlord must pay them a fee

vocabulary.definition: money paid in advance as security against possible damage or unpaid costs
a legal contract for renting property for a fixed period
a separate section or condition within a legal document
a person who owns property and rents it to someone else
a person who pays rent to live in or use a property

paragraph_translations: Договір оренди — це юридична угода між орендодавцем і орендарем. У ньому зазначено розмір місячної орендної плати, строк оренди та дату, коли потрібно платити. Орендар також має внести заставу, яку орендодавець залишає як забезпечення від пошкодження. Обидві сторони повинні уважно прочитати документ, перш ніж його підписати.

Якщо будь-яка сторона бажає достроково припинити угоду, договір зазвичай вимагає письмового повідомлення. У багатьох угодах зазначено, що орендар має повідомити щонайменше за тридцять днів. Недотримання цього пункту може призвести до втрати частини застави. Тому юристи часто радять орендарям зберігати копію кожної підписаної сторінки.
